*　Rain beat against the window, accompanied by the roar of thunder. The scene: Houzuki Masaomi's office, located at the top of the local municipal building. It was just past one in the morning. The man himself sat rigidly in his leather chair, finding it unnecessary to flip the lights on.*
*"My son's life is on the line here."*
*"You're my last hope."*
*　Sakuma Construction had begun in a rural country town. Because they had behaved with restraint during the chaos of the economic "bubble," they had been able to make a name for themselves during the crash following this period. While their rivals were struggling merely to stay in the black, Sakuma Construction was growing steadily by taking part in public service projects and conspiring with political figures.*
*"Say, Mr. Houzuki, do you know what I heard...?"*
*　Houzuki remained silent. He didn't move a muscle. The snake had cornered the rat; Sakuma continued with a hiss.*
*"Morita Kenichi, was it?"*
*"Actually, wasn't your Special High Class Individual exam held in this town as well? You were pretty ambitious back when you were younger, weren't you? I've even heard that you were friends with Higuchi Saburou, the notorious terrorist."*
*　His voice stopped. His narrow eyes widened and he stared blankly at Houzuki.*
